overview: MediReach is a fully trilingual (English, Telugu, Hindi) rural healthcare platform prototype connecting patients, doctors, pharmacists, and administrators with role-based dashboards and functional care-management pages.
features: Trilingual English/Telugu/Hindi interface with persistent language selector
Role-based demo login for Patient, Pharmacist, Doctor, and Healthcare Admin
Four functional role dashboards with mock data and charts
Eight prototype pages: appointments, referrals, teleconsultation, triage, diagnostics, medicine availability, high-risk follow-up, facility monitoring
Offline/online resilience and accessibility for low-connectivity rural use
